context: a letter from John (b) Murray, which you are answering
exchanges:
I have this day got back the first portion of your MS. wch shall be delivered to your Servant whenever he may call—

The remainder will be in my hands Saty. morng & will also be delivered—if called for.

I will not decide on the No. to be printed until I can read a good portion— Our agreement will apply only to First Edition

My Dear Sir | Yours very faithfully | John Murray

Chas Darwin Esq

Many thanks. After all I now find, on account of my servant & Horses, I cannot send till Saturday for the M.S. & then my servant can bring all & I will, as soon as it is marked, send all to Mess. Clowes in Stamford St—

I feel a full conviction that my Chapter on man will excite attention & plenty of abuse & I suppose abuse is as good as praise for selling a Book.—

Yours sincerely | C. Darwin
